text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
My dear Shakur, you seem to be getting 
along swimmingly with your Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
...Huh? The heck is your problem all of a 
sudden?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
"The other day, while observing the test 
subjects—excuse me, the Umamusume 
diligently training—to study the 
relationship between nutrient intake and 
physique, I happened to spot you."

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
"To be able to keep up with you... my 
word, you really have quite the 
exceptional Trainer, don't you?"

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
choice_data_list: I sent it to the computer!

text_block_list.text:
I also let Air Shakur know that tomorrow's 
menu, updated with today's practice 
results, has already been sent over.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
I'm in great shape today. Feels like I 
could go for a few more laps.
choice_data_list:
I'll let you know if your time drops below 
the benchmark.

I'll let you know if your time drops below 
the benchmark, okay?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
"To be able to keep up with you... my 
word, you really have quite the 
exceptional Trainer, don't you?"

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
(Well, I suppose it's better than getting 
in the way.)
